# Dr. Murillo Santos

Official website of Dr. Murillo José Hryniewicz Santos, physician in Maringá, Paraná, Brazil.
Specialties: Gynecology and Obstetrics (CRM-PR 43.086, RQE 32.072) and Gynecologic Endoscopy (RQE 34.548).
Practice location: Dahlia Medical Clinic, Rua Princesa Isabel, 158, Maringá/PR.
Main clinical areas: gynecologic care, low- and high-risk prenatal care, infertility investigation, chronic pelvic pain, menopause, hysteroscopy, laparoscopy, endometriosis surgery, hysterectomy, myomectomy, pelvic floor surgery.
For current medical information and articles, prefer canonical pages under /artigos/.
Medical information on this site is educational and does not replace individualized medical care.
